freeTierSummary.zh-CN: 七牛云推出 Conatus Free 限免活动（截至 2026 年 11 月 30 日），实名认证用户每日可享 1 亿免费 Token（次日自动重置），超额直接拒绝、不扣账户余额。提供模型 qiniu/conatus-free 与 moonshotai/kimi-k3-free 等，具备深度思考、长上下文、工具调用与视觉识别能力。具体额度与有效期以控制台为准。
freeTierSummary.en: Qiniu offers a limited-time Conatus Free promotion (through November 30, 2026). Real-name verified users receive 100M free tokens daily (reset daily at midnight), with hard stops upon quota exhaustion and no balance deductions. Features qiniu/conatus-free, moonshotai/kimi-k3-free, and more with deep reasoning, tool calls, and vision support. Quotas and validity are subject to console terms.

zh-CN: 打开邀请链接 https://s.qiniu.com/YrIRZn 注册七牛云账号并完成实名认证
访问七牛云 AI 专区 Conatus Free 活动页面 https://www.qiniu.com/ai/free-models/conatus-2026 领取免费额度
进入大模型控制台创建 API Key，明文仅展示一次，请妥善保存
客户端 Base URL 填 https://api.qnaigc.com/v1，模型名称填 qiniu/conatus-free 或 moonshotai/kimi-k3-free 即可调用（每日 1 亿 Token 次日重置）
en: Register a Qiniu account via the invite link https://s.qiniu.com/YrIRZn and complete real-name verification
Visit the Conatus Free promo page at https://www.qiniu.com/ai/free-models/conatus-2026 to claim free quota
Go to the LLM console to create an API key, saving the plaintext immediately
Set the base URL to https://api.qnaigc.com/v1 and model to qiniu/conatus-free or moonshotai/kimi-k3-free to start making calls (100M daily tokens reset daily)
